title: Aesop's Fables — Easy Readers
zh_title: 伊索寓言 · 分级阅读
author: Aesop (retold for learners)
intro_en: Aesop's Fables are short, wise stories from long ago. In each tale, animals talk and act like people, and the story ends with a simple lesson. These easy versions use short sentences, so new readers can enjoy them and read aloud with confidence.
intro_zh: 《伊索寓言》是很久以前流传下来的短小而充满智慧的故事。故事里的动物像人一样说话、行动,每个故事的结尾都有一个简单的道理。本册用简短的句子改写,方便初学者阅读,也适合大声朗读。
copyright_note: Public-domain fables of Aesop, retold in simple original English for young learners. 伊索寓言属公有领域;本册为面向初学者的简易改写(措辞原创),非任何现行教材节选。

paragraphs.en: A hare laughed at a tortoise.
paragraphs.cn: 一只兔子嘲笑一只乌龟。

paragraphs.en: "You are so slow!" he said.
"Let's have a race," said the tortoise.
The hare thought this was very funny.
The race began, and the hare ran fast.
paragraphs.cn: 比赛开始了,兔子跑得飞快。

paragraphs.en: Soon he was far ahead.
"I have time to rest," he said, and fell asleep.
paragraphs.cn: “我有时间休息,”他说着就睡着了。

paragraphs.en: The tortoise walked on and on.
He passed the sleeping hare.
paragraphs.cn: 他经过了正在睡觉的兔子。

paragraphs.en: When the hare woke up, the tortoise had won.
paragraphs.cn: 兔子醒来时,乌龟已经赢了。

paragraphs.en: Slow and steady wins the race.
A lion was asleep in the sun.
paragraphs.cn: 一只狮子在阳光下睡觉。

paragraphs.en: A little mouse ran over his nose.
paragraphs.cn: 一只小老鼠从他的鼻子上跑过。

paragraphs.en: The lion woke up and caught the mouse.
"Please let me go," cried the mouse.
"One day I may help you."
The lion laughed, but he let the mouse go.
paragraphs.cn: 狮子笑了,但还是放走了老鼠。

paragraphs.en: Later, the lion was caught in a net.
paragraphs.cn: 后来,狮子被困在了网里。

paragraphs.en: He roared, but he could not get free.
The little mouse heard him.
She ran over and bit the ropes.
Soon the lion was free.
Even a small friend can be a great help.
paragraphs.cn: 再小的朋友也能帮上大忙。

paragraphs.en: A hungry fox saw some grapes.
paragraphs.cn: 一只饥饿的狐狸看见了一些葡萄。

paragraphs.en: They hung high on a vine.
"Those grapes look sweet," he said.
The fox jumped up, but he missed.
He tried again and again.
Each time, he could not reach them.
At last, the fox walked away.
"I don't want them," he said.
"They are sour anyway."
It is easy to hate what you cannot have.
paragraphs.cn: 得不到的东西,就容易去讨厌它。

paragraphs.en: In summer, an ant worked hard.
paragraphs.cn: 夏天,一只蚂蚁辛勤地劳作。

paragraphs.en: She saved food for the winter.
A grasshopper sang all day.
"Why work so much?" he asked.
"Come and play with me!"
"There is plenty of food now."
But the ant did not stop.
Then winter came, and it was cold.
The grasshopper had no food.
The ant was warm and full.
It is wise to prepare for hard days.
paragraphs.cn: 未雨绸缪才是明智之举。
